description: Compact qualifier set that distinguishes incompatible reporting definitions for the same metric ID.

attribution_window.description: A time duration expressed as an interval and unit. Used for frequency cap windows, attribution windows, reach optimization windows, time budgets, and other time-based settings. When unit is 'campaign', interval must be 1 — the window spans the full campaign flight.

interval.description: Number of time units. Must be 1 when unit is 'campaign'.

attribution_window.title: Duration
